sections.label: Tips & traps
sections.sub: The stuff people wish they'd known
sections.heading: Don't get caught out
items: Approval only builds while a companion is IN your active party — swap people in for big story beats.
You need ~40 camp supplies to Long Rest (80 on Tactician). Under that you only get a weak partial rest, so grab every sausage and bottle.
Long Rest often — camp scenes, romance and questlines advance there — but a few quests fail if you rest too much before resolving them.
You get 2 Short Rests per day (50% HP + short-rest abilities). Use them before burning a Long Rest.
High ground gives +2 to hit, and you can shove or jump enemies off ledges — positioning wins fights more than raw damage.

sections.label: Act 1 — don't leave without…
sections.heading: Act 1 — don't leave without…
items: Recruit all 6 companions above before advancing the story.
The Underdark and the Mountain Pass are BOTH still Act 1 — explore both before the point of no return.
The Zhentarim hideout, the Grymforge, and the Githyanki Creche each gate unique gear and quests.
Resolve the Grove (save or side against the tieflings) before triggering the goblin raid.
Grab your class's key Act 1 gear — a lot of it is permanently missable once you leave.
